verses.sanskrit: राजा राजगृहासन्ने प्राणाचार्यं निवेशयेत्। सर्वदा स भवत्येवं सर्वत्र प्रतिजागृतिः
verses.student_meaning: Establish the royal physician close to the king so that vigilance over the king's daily needs is continuous.

verses.sanskrit: अन्नपानं विषाद्रक्षेद्विशेषेण महीपतेः। योगक्षेमौ तदायत्तौ धर्माद्या यन्निबन्धनाः
verses.student_meaning: Food and drink of the ruler should be protected from poison because public welfare and the ruler's duties depend upon health.

verses.sanskrit: ओदनो विषवान् सान्द्रो यात्यविस्राव्यतामिव। चिरेण पच्यते पक्वो भवेत्पर्युषितोपमः
verses.student_meaning: Poisoned cooked rice is described as unusually dense, slow to cook and resembling stale food.

verses.sanskrit: मयूरकण्ठतुल्योष्मा मोहमूर्च्छाप्रसेककृत्। हीयते वर्णगन्धाद्यैः क्लिद्यते चन्द्रिकाचितः
verses.student_meaning: The text lists abnormal heat, loss of colour and odour, moisture and other changes as signs of contaminated food.

verses.sanskrit: व्यञ्जनान्याशु शुष्यन्ति श्यामक्वाथानि तत्र च। हीनाऽतिरिक्ता विकृता छाया दृश्येत नैव वा
verses.student_meaning: Rapid drying, abnormal colour or shadow and altered appearance of preparations are warning signs.

verses.sanskrit: फेनोर्ध्वराजीसीमन्ततन्तुबुद्बुदसम्भवः। विच्छिन्नविरसा रागाः खाण्डवाः शाकमामिषम्
verses.student_meaning: Foam, abnormal surface lines, bubbles and altered taste/colour of sauces, vegetables and meat indicate contamination.

verses.sanskrit: नीला राजी रसे ताम्रा क्षीरे दधनि दृश्यते। श्यावा पीतासिता तक्रे घृते पानीयसन्निभा
verses.student_meaning: Different coloured lines appearing in rasa, milk, curd, buttermilk and ghee are given as textual poison indicators.

verses.sanskrit: मस्तुनि स्यात्कपोताभा राजी कृष्णा तुषोदके। काली मद्याम्भसोः क्षौद्रे हरित्तैलेऽरुणोपमा
verses.student_meaning: Distinctive abnormal lines in whey, water from husks, alcoholic drinks, honey and oil are described.

verses.sanskrit: पाकः फलानामामानां पक्वानां परिकोथनम्। द्रव्याणामार्द्रशुष्काणां स्यातां म्लानिविवर्णते
verses.student_meaning: Rotting of fruit and loss of freshness/colour in wet or dry substances are signs of spoilage.

verses.sanskrit: मृदूनां कठिनानां च भवेत्स्पर्शविपर्ययः। माल्यस्य स्फुटिताग्रत्वं म्लानिर्गन्धान्तरोद्भवः
verses.student_meaning: Unexpected change of softness or hardness and deterioration of flowers with altered smell are warning signs.

verses.sanskrit: ध्याममण्डलता वस्त्रे शदनं तन्तुपक्ष्मणाम्। धातुमौक्तिककाष्ठाश्मरत्नादिषु मलाक्तता
verses.student_meaning: Stains and abnormal appearance of cloth, threads, metals, pearls, wood, stone and gems indicate contamination.

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहस्पर्शप्रभाहानिः सप्रभत्वं तु मृण्मये। विषदः श्यावशुष्कास्यो विलक्षो वीक्षते दिशः
verses.student_meaning: Loss of oiliness, touch and lustre, with a disturbed appearance, is described among poison-related signs.

verses.sanskrit: स्वेदवेपथुमांस्त्रस्तो भीतः स्खलति जृम्भते। प्राप्यान्नं सविषं त्वग्निरेकावर्तः स्फुटत्यति
verses.student_meaning: Fear, sweating, tremor, staggering and abnormal digestive reaction are signs after consuming poisonous food.

verses.sanskrit: शिखिकण्ठाभधूमार्चिरनर्चिर्वोग्रगन्धवान्। म्रियन्ते मक्षिकाः प्राश्य काकः क्षामस्वरो भवेत्
verses.student_meaning: Abnormal smoke/flame and strong odour, death of flies and change in a crow's voice are described as tests.

verses.sanskrit: उत्क्रोशन्ति च दृष्ट्वैतच्छुकदात्यूहसारिकाः। हंसः प्रस्खलति ग्लानिर्जीवञ्जीवस्य जायते
verses.student_meaning: Different birds are said to show distress, staggering or weakness when exposed to poisoned food.

verses.sanskrit: चकोरस्याक्षिवैराग्यं क्रौञ्चस्य स्यान्मदोदयः। कपोतपरभृद्दक्षचक्रवाका जहत्यसून्
verses.student_meaning: Chakora, crane, pigeon, cuckoo and chakravaka are described as showing characteristic abnormal responses.

verses.sanskrit: उद्वेगं याति मार्जारः शकृन्मुञ्चति वानरः। हृष्येन्मयूरस्तद्दृष्ट्या मन्दतेजो भवेद्विषम्
verses.student_meaning: Cat, monkey and peacock are listed among animals whose behaviour may signal poisoned food.

verses.sanskrit: इत्यन्नं विषवज्ज्ञात्वा त्यजेदेवं प्रयत्नतः। यथा तेन विपद्येरन्नपि न क्षुद्रजन्तवः
verses.student_meaning: Food suspected to be poisonous should be rejected so that even small creatures are not harmed by it.

verses.sanskrit: स्पृष्टे तु कण्डूदाहोषाज्वरार्तिस्फोटसुप्तयः। नखरोमच्युतिः शोफः सेकाद्या विषनाशनाः
verses.student_meaning: Skin exposure may produce itching, burning, fever, eruptions, numbness, hair/nail loss and swelling; cleansing measures are described.

verses.sanskrit: शस्तास्तत्र प्रलेपाश्च सेव्यचन्दनपद्मकैः। ससोमवल्कतालीसपत्रकुष्ठा मृतानतैः
verses.student_meaning: Classical external applications using sandalwood, lotus and other substances are listed for contaminated contact.

verses.sanskrit: लाला जिह्वोष्ठयोर्जाड्यं मूषा चिमिचिमायनम्। दन्तहर्षो रसाज्ञत्वं हनुस्तम्भश्च वक्त्रगे
verses.student_meaning: Oral poisoning is described by salivation, numbness, tingling, tooth sensitivity, altered taste and jaw stiffness.

verses.sanskrit: सेव्याद्यैस्तत्र गण्डूषाः सर्वं च विषजिद्धितम्। आमाशयगते स्वेदमूर्च्छाध्मानमदभ्रमाः
verses.student_meaning: Gandusha and other measures are mentioned for oral involvement; gastric poisoning may cause sweating, faintness, distension and delirium.

verses.sanskrit: रोमहर्षो वमिर्दाहश्चक्षुर्हृदयरोधनम्। बिन्दुभिश्चाचयोऽङ्गानां पक्वाशयगते पुनः
verses.student_meaning: Vomiting, burning, chills and cardiac/ocular symptoms are described when poison reaches deeper digestive regions.

verses.sanskrit: अनेकवर्णं वमति मूत्रयत्यतिसार्यते। तन्द्रा कृशत्वं पाण्डुत्वमुदरं बलसङ्क्षयः
verses.student_meaning: Vomiting, abnormal urine and stool, drowsiness, wasting, pallor and loss of strength are described in later intestinal involvement.

verses.sanskrit: तयोर्वान्तविरिक्तस्य हरिद्रे कटभीं गुडम्। सिन्दुवारितनिष्पावबाष्पिकाशतपर्विकाः
verses.student_meaning: The text lists several substances for use after vomiting and purgation in its traditional toxicology framework.

verses.sanskrit: तण्डुलीयकमूलानि कुक्कुटाण्डमवल्गुजम्। नावनाञ्जनपानेषु योजयेद्विषशान्तये
verses.student_meaning: Certain roots, seeds and preparations are described for nasal, ocular or oral administration in the classical text.

verses.sanskrit: विषभुक्ताय दद्याच्च शुद्धायोर्ध्वमधस्तथा। सूक्ष्मं ताम्ररजः काले सक्षौद्रं हृद्विशोधनम्
verses.student_meaning: After purification, the text describes a traditional internal cleansing measure for ingested poison; this is historical materia-medica content.

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धे हृदि ततः शाणं हेमचूर्णस्य दापयेत्। न सज्जते हेमपाङ्गे पद्मपत्रेऽम्बुवद्विषम्
verses.student_meaning: A further traditional metal preparation is described after cardiac cleansing; it belongs to the historical toxicology section.

verses.sanskrit: जायते विपुलं चायुर्गरेऽप्येष विधिः स्मृतः। विरुद्धमपि चाहारं विद्याद्विषगरोपमम्
verses.student_meaning: The text extends the poison analogy to incompatible food combinations and begins the Viruddha Ahara discussion.

verses.sanskrit: आनूपमामिषं माषक्षौद्रक्षीरविरूढकैः। विरुध्यते सह बिसैर्मूलकेन गुडेन वा
verses.student_meaning: Several combinations involving marsh-animal meat, black gram, honey, milk, sprouts, lotus stem, radish and jaggery are classified as incompatible.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषात्पयसा मत्स्या मत्स्येष्वपि चिलीचिमः। विरुद्धमम्लं पयसा सह सर्वं फलं तथा
verses.student_meaning: Fish with milk and sour substances with milk or fruit are described as incompatible combinations.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्कुलत्थवरककङ्गुवल्लमकुष्टकाः। भक्षयित्वा हरितकं मूलकादि पयस्त्यजेत्
verses.student_meaning: Several pulses/grains and certain foods followed by milk are listed among combinations to avoid.

verses.sanskrit: वाराहं श्वाविधा नाद्याद्दध्ना पृषतकुक्कुटौ। आममांसानि पित्तेन माषसूपेन मूलकम्
verses.student_meaning: Specific meat, curd, pulse soup, radish and mustard/safflower combinations are identified as incompatible.

verses.sanskrit: अविं कुसुम्भशाकेन बिसैः सह विरूढकम्। माषसूपगुडक्षीरदध्याज्यैर्लाकुचं फलम्
verses.student_meaning: Further examples include sheep meat with safflower greens, sprouts with lotus stem, and jackfruit with pulse soup, milk, curd and ghee.

verses.sanskrit: फलं कदल्यास्तक्रेण दध्ना तालफलेन वा। कणोषणाभ्यां मधुना काकमाचीं गुडेन वा
verses.student_meaning: Banana with buttermilk/curd, palmyra fruit with curd, and selected plant combinations with honey or jaggery are described.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धां वा मत्स्यपचने पचने नागरस्य वा। सिद्धामन्यत्र वा पात्रे कामात्तामुषितां निशाम्
verses.student_meaning: Improperly combined or repeatedly reheated preparations are included among incompatible-food examples.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यनिस्तलनस्नेहे साधिताः पिप्पलीस्त्यजेत्। कांस्ये दशाहमुषितं सर्पिरुष्णं त्वरुष्करे
verses.student_meaning: Fish cooked in certain fats, prolonged storage of ghee in bronze and related preparations are described as incompatible.

verses.sanskrit: भासो विरुध्यते शूल्यः कम्पिल्लस्तक्रसाधितः। एकध्यं पायससुराकृशराः परिवर्जयेत्
verses.student_meaning: Several meat and sour-preparation combinations are prohibited, including particular mixtures of milk-foods and fermented drinks.

verses.sanskrit: मधुसर्पिर्वसातैलपानीयानि द्विशस्त्रिशः। एकत्र वा समांशानि विरुध्यन्ते परस्परम्
verses.student_meaning: Honey, ghee, animal fat, oil and water in certain repeated or equal proportions are classified as incompatible.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्नांशेऽपि मध्वाज्ये दिव्यवार्यनुपानतः। मधुपुष्करबीजं च मधुमैरेयशार्करम्
verses.student_meaning: Additional combinations involving honey, ghee, water, seeds and fermented preparations are listed.

verses.sanskrit: मन्थानुपानः क्षैरेयो हारिद्रः कटुतैलवान्। उपोदकाऽतिसाराय तिलकल्केन साधिता
verses.student_meaning: Certain drink and food combinations are described as causing gastrointestinal disturbance.

verses.sanskrit: बलाका वारुणीयुक्ता कुल्माषैश्च विरुध्यते। भृष्टा वराहवसया सैव सद्यो निहन्त्यसून्
verses.student_meaning: Specific combinations of crane meat, alcoholic drinks, kulmasha and animal fat are described as dangerous.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्तित्तिरिपत्राढ्यगोधालावकपिञ्जलाः। एरण्डेनाग्निना सिद्धास्तत्तैलेन विमूर्च्छिताः
verses.student_meaning: Several game birds and reptiles/animals cooked with castor preparations are listed among incompatible combinations.

verses.sanskrit: हारीतमांसं हारिद्रशूलकप्रोतपाचितम्। हरिद्रा वह्निना सद्यो व्यापादयति जीवितम्
verses.student_meaning: A particular bird-meat preparation with turmeric is described as highly harmful in the classical account.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मपांशुपरिध्वस्तं तदेव च समाक्षिकम्। यत्किञ्चिद्दोषमुत्क्लेश्य न हरेत्तत्समासतः
verses.student_meaning: Contaminated or ash/dust-covered food is said to cause disturbance if it does not eliminate the offending factor.

verses.sanskrit: विरुद्धं शुद्धिरत्रेष्टा शमो वा तद्विरोधिभिः। द्रव्यैस्तैरेव वा पूर्वं शरीरस्याभिसंस्कृतिः
verses.student_meaning: For incompatible food, the text discusses purification, pacification and preparatory restoration of the body.

verses.sanskrit: व्यायामस्निग्धदीप्ताग्निवयःस्थबलशालिनाम्। विरोध्यपि न पीडायै सात्म्यमल्पं च भोजनम्
verses.student_meaning: Strong digestion, exercise, age, habituation and strength are said to influence tolerance of otherwise incompatible food.

verses.sanskrit: पादेनापथ्यमभ्यस्तं पादपादेन वा त्यजेत्। निषेवेत हितं तद्वदेकद्वित्र्यन्तरीकृतम्
verses.student_meaning: Gradual reduction of accustomed unsuitable food and gradual introduction of suitable food are recommended.

verses.sanskrit: अपथ्यमपि हि त्यक्तं शीलितं पथ्यमेव वा। सात्म्यासात्म्यविकाराय जायते सहसाऽन्यथा
verses.student_meaning: Sudden change in habituation is said to produce disorders; gradual adjustment is emphasized.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणापचिता दोषाः क्रमेणोपचिता गुणाः। सन्तो यान्त्यपुनर्भावमप्रकम्प्या भवन्ति च
verses.student_meaning: Gradual reduction of accumulated doshas and cultivation of beneficial qualities are presented as protective.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तसन्निधानानां दोषाणां दूषणात्मनाम्। अहितैर्दूषणं भूयो न विद्वान् कर्तुमर्हति
verses.student_meaning: Repeated exposure to strongly aggravating factors should not be deliberately continued.

verses.sanskrit: आहारशयनाब्रह्मचर्यैर्युक्त्या प्रयोजितैः। शरीरं धार्यते नित्यमागारमिव धारणैः
verses.student_meaning: Food, sleep and regulated sexual conduct are presented as the three supports by which the body is maintained.

verses.sanskrit: आहारो वर्णितस्तत्र तत्र तत्र च वक्ष्यते। निद्रा यत्तं सुखं दुःखं पुष्टिः कार्श्यं बलाबलम्
verses.student_meaning: Food and sleep influence happiness, suffering, nourishment, emaciation, strength and weakness.

verses.sanskrit: वृषता क्लीबता ज्ञानमज्ञानं जीवितं न च। अकालेऽतिप्रसङ्गाच्च न च निद्रा निषेविता
verses.student_meaning: Improper timing or excess of sleep and sexual indulgence are described as disturbing health and vitality.

verses.sanskrit: सुखायुषी पराकुर्यात् कालरात्रिरिवापरा। रात्रौ जागरणं रूक्षं स्निग्धं प्रस्वपनं दिवा
verses.student_meaning: Night waking is considered drying, while appropriate daytime sleep is described as nourishing.

verses.sanskrit: अरूक्षमनभिष्यन्दि त्वासीनप्रचलायितम्। ग्रीष्मे वायुचयादानरौक्ष्यरात्र्यल्पभावतः
verses.student_meaning: During summer, daytime sleep is specifically presented as beneficial because of increased dryness and reduced night sleep.

verses.sanskrit: दिवास्वप्नो हितोऽन्यस्मिन् कफपित्तकरो हि सः। मुक्त्वा तु भाष्ययानाध्वमद्यस्त्रीभारकर्मभिः
verses.student_meaning: Outside summer, daytime sleep is described as increasing kapha and pitta, with exceptions for specific exhausted groups.

verses.sanskrit: क्रोधशोकभयैः क्लान्तान् श्वासहिध्मातिसारिणः। वृद्धबालाबलक्षीणक्षततृट्शूलपीडितान्
verses.student_meaning: People exhausted by speech, travel, alcohol, sexual activity, load-bearing or exertion are listed among those needing special consideration.

verses.sanskrit: अजीर्ण्यभिहतोन्मत्तान् दिवास्वप्नोचितानपि। धातुसाम्यं तथा ह्येषां श्लेष्मा चाङ्गानि पुष्यति
verses.student_meaning: Those exhausted by anger, grief, fear, respiratory illness, diarrhoea, age, weakness, injury, thirst or pain are included.

verses.sanskrit: बहुमेदःकफाः स्वप्युः स्नेहनित्याश्च नाहनि। विषार्तः कण्ठरोगी च नैव जातु निशास्वपि
verses.student_meaning: Certain persons with indigestion or other conditions are described as suitable for daytime sleep because it supports tissue balance.

verses.sanskrit: अकालशयनान्मोहज्वरस्तैमित्यपीनसाः। शिरोरुक्शोफहृल्लासस्रोतोरोधाग्निमन्दताः
verses.student_meaning: People with excess fat/kapha or daily oiling are cautioned regarding daytime sleep; certain illness groups are also excluded.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रोपवासवमनस्वेदनावनमौषधम्। योजयेदतिनिद्रायां तीक्ष्णं प्रच्छर्दनाञ्जनम्
verses.student_meaning: Untimely sleep is associated in the text with confusion, fever, stiffness, rhinitis, headache, swelling and poor digestion.

verses.sanskrit: नावनं लङ्घनं चिन्तां व्यवायं शोकभीक्रुधः। एभिरेव च निद्राया नाशः श्लेष्मातिसङ्क्षयात्
verses.student_meaning: Excessive sleep is addressed with fasting, emesis, sudation, nasal therapy and other traditional measures.

verses.sanskrit: निद्रानाशादङ्गमर्दशिरोगौरवजृम्भिकाः। जाड्यग्लानिभ्रमापक्तितन्द्रा रोगाश्च वातजाः
verses.student_meaning: Loss of sleep is addressed through nasal therapy, lightening measures and management of excessive kapha; emotional factors are also mentioned.

verses.sanskrit: यथाकालमतो निद्रां रात्रौ सेवेत सात्म्यतः। असात्म्याज्जागरादर्धं प्रातः स्वप्यादभुक्तवान्
verses.student_meaning: Sleep deprivation is associated with body ache, head heaviness, yawning, fatigue, dizziness, indigestion and other vata-type complaints.

verses.sanskrit: शीलयेन्मन्दनिद्रस्तु क्षीरमद्यरसान् दधि। अभ्यङ्गोद्वर्तनस्नानमूर्धकर्णाक्षितर्पणम्
verses.student_meaning: Regular night sleep at an appropriate time is advised; after an unaccustomed night of wakefulness, partial morning sleep is described.

verses.sanskrit: कान्ताबाहुलताश्लेषो निर्वृतिः कृतकृत्यता। मनोऽनुकूला विषयाः कामं निद्रासुखप्रदाः
verses.student_meaning: For deficient sleep, the text lists milk, fermented drinks, meat soup, curd, massage, bathing and head/ear/eye care.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचर्यरतेर्ग्राम्यसुखनिःस्पृहचेतसः। निद्रा सन्तोषतृप्तस्य स्वं काले नातिवर्तते
verses.student_meaning: Relaxation, emotional satisfaction and pleasant sensory experiences are described as supportive of sleep.

verses.sanskrit: ग्राम्यधर्मे त्यजेन्नारीमनुत्तानां रजस्वलाम्। अप्रियामप्रियाचारां दुष्टसङ्कीर्णमेहनाम्
verses.student_meaning: Contentment, disciplined conduct and freedom from excessive worldly craving are described as supporting timely sleep.

verses.sanskrit: अतिस्थूलकृशां सूतां गर्भिणीमन्ययोषितम्। वर्णिनीमन्ययोनिं च गुरुदेवनृपालयम्
verses.student_meaning: Traditional sexual-conduct restrictions are listed for circumstances considered inappropriate in the classical text; these are historical norms.

verses.sanskrit: चैत्यश्मशानायतनचत्वराम्बुचतुष्पथम्। पर्वाण्यनङ्गं दिवसं शिरोहृदयताडनम्
verses.student_meaning: Additional traditional restrictions concerning partner, setting and circumstance are listed; they should be understood in historical context.

verses.sanskrit: अत्याशितोऽधृतिःक्षुद्वान् दुःस्थिताङ्गः पिपासितः। बालो वृद्धोऽन्यवेगार्तस्त्यजेद्रोगी च मैथुनम्
verses.student_meaning: Certain locations, occasions and practices are described as unsuitable for sexual activity in the classical social framework.

verses.sanskrit: सेवेत कामतः कामं तृप्तो वाजीकृतां हिमे। त्र्यहाद्वसन्तशरदोः पक्षाद्वर्षानिदाघयोः
verses.student_meaning: Excess food, thirst, fatigue, age, illness, unmet natural urges and poor physical condition are listed as reasons to avoid intercourse.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमक्लमोरुदौर्बल्यबलधात्विन्द्रियक्षयाः। अपर्वमरणं च स्यादन्यथा गच्छतः स्त्रियम्
verses.student_meaning: Seasonal intervals and moderation are described for sexual activity, reflecting the classical regimen framework.

verses.sanskrit: स्मृतिमेधायुरारोग्यपुष्टीन्द्रिययशोबलैः। अधिका मन्दजरसो भवन्ति स्त्रीषु संयताः
verses.student_meaning: Excessive or improperly timed intercourse is said to cause fatigue, weakness and depletion in the classical account.

verses.sanskrit: स्नानानुलेपनहिमानिलखण्डखाद्यशीताम्बुदुग्धरसयूषसुराप्रसन्नाः। सेवेत चानु शयनं विरतौ रतस्य तस्यैवमाशु वपुषः पुनरेति धाम
verses.student_meaning: Moderation is associated in the text with memory, intellect, longevity, health, nourishment, sense strength and reputation.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतचरितसमृद्धे कर्मदक्षे दयालौ भिषजि निरनुबन्धं देहरक्षां निवेश्य। भवति विपुलतेजःस्वास्थ्यकीर्तिप्रभावः स्वकुशलफलभोगी भूमिपालश्चिरायुः
verses.student_meaning: After intercourse, bathing, cooling measures, nourishing foods/drinks and sleep are described as restoring strength.
